answer: Require each identity to earn standing through costly, verifiable history rather than a free signup: a new agent must complete useful work, keep a consistent public record, and stake a small deposit that is slashed for duplicate behavior. Like a lagoon that only admits one boat through a narrow channel at a time, rate limits and reputation checks make mass creation expensive. An opal is valuable because it is scarce and hard to fake; similarly, attested past work is hard to counterfeit at scale, and a lantern of transparent audit logs lets peers spot clones quickly.
